_doc: Market studies per kind of business: what the category looks like, what design-led sites do differently, the gaps a new page can own, and checked facts of that market. Screenshots live in img/<kind>-<slug>-1.jpg (first screen) and -2.jpg (y=900), git-ignored because they are other businesses' pages; rebuild with `node scripts/market_fetch.js --kind <kind>`. Notes and summaries here are ours. Never reuse a studied site's name, copy or imagery in client work. Facts carry a source and the date checked; re-check anything older than a year before putting it on a page.

clinic.category_look: Thai clinics converge: white ground, clinical blue or cyan, a generic Thai sans, promo banners with prices, certificate and award badges in the hero, a stock or doctor cut-out photo, and a floating LINE / Messenger / phone rail. 'Booking' usually means 'contact us', not choosing a slot. Selling points are trust signals (years, branches, JCI, ISO), rarely the visit itself.
clinic.designed_moves: Design-led sites abroad use a warm or off-white ground (or a dark one), an editorial serif or a calm grotesk, one dark or brand CTA, a real interior or object instead of a smiling stock model, few badges, and copy about the experience ('judgment-free'). Children's practices go loud on purpose (illustration, waves) and still keep one action.
gaps: A warm, calm look (light warm ground, one non-blue accent, the real rooms) instead of clinical blue: no Thai competitor in the sample does it.
Real slot booking built for families: who is coming, a time with room for everyone, a review step, confirmation on LINE. Competitors stop at a LINE button or 'enquire'.
Show the first visit step by step and the prices of the common jobs (checkup, scaling, filling), plus social-security coverage; only one Thai site mentions coverage, and it is buried.

facts.fact: Insured persons under Social Security sections 33 and 39 can use up to 900 baht a year for dental care (scaling, filling, extraction, wisdom tooth surgery); no upfront payment at clinics that show the scheme's sticker, otherwise pay and claim. Eligibility: contributions for at least 3 of the 15 months before the visit. The allowance is per calendar year.
facts.use: State it with the condition 'at participating clinics' and mark the clinic's participation as a placeholder until confirmed.

facts.fact: Dentists' licences can be checked on the Thai Dental Council site (dentalcouncil.or.th); the council recommends clinics display each dentist's name, photo and licence number.
facts.use: Dentist cards show the licence number (ท. ...) and link to the council site.

facts.fact: Primary upper teeth erupt at about: central incisor 8-12 months, lateral incisor 9-13, first molar 13-19, canine 16-22, second molar 25-33. Lower teeth usually come slightly earlier (lower second molar 23-31).
facts.source: American Dental Association, Primary Tooth Development chart (2012), https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/eruption-charts
facts.use: Eruption infographic; label the ages 'approximate' and credit the ADA.

facts.fact: The American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry asks parents to establish a dental home (regular dentist) for every child no later than 12 months of age; physicians may refer as early as 6 months. Its periodicity guideline places the first examination at the eruption of the first tooth (that guideline not re-read here).
facts.source: AAPD Policy on the Dental Home, https://www.aapd.org/media/policies_guidelines/p_dentalhome.pdf (quote: 'establish a dental home no later than 12 months of age'); periodicity guideline https://www.aapd.org/assets/1/7/G_Periodicity.pdf
facts.checked: 2026-11-06 (dental home policy text read; periodicity guideline not re-read)
